summary: Frontend-only regression for the executive-outcome design pivot. Verified sidebar renaming/sections, simplified topbar, PageHero on all 8 dashboard pages with exact questions & North Star values, two Growth Loop cards on Overview, Customer Signals theme cards, updated login chip ('Uplaud · Growth Engine'), PageHero CTA routing (overview→interactions and no-op when to:null), and reset-workspace flow. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: PageHero: TrendIcon branches for up/down but assigns the same green color for both — trend='down-good' is handled correctly, but if a true 'down-bad' trend is ever passed it will still render mint green. Non-blocking for this iteration since only up/down-good are used.
DashboardLayout Topbar: still imports Search and Plus icons which are no longer used. Minor unused import cleanup.
InsightsPage: 'Explore attribution, channels & trends' link is a placeholder href='#' — acceptable per spec (KPI/attribution intentionally removed) but should be either wired or removed in future.
test_credentials: Mocked auth via localStorage: uplaud_business_auth_v1={email,name,workspace} + uplaud_business_imported_v1='true'. Any email/password works on login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Design pivot verified end-to-end. All 9 nav items render with new outcome labels under 5 sections + Settings at bottom. Topbar has no search input, no 'New campaign' button; bell + avatar only. PageHero (data-testid=page-hero, page-hero-eyebrow, page-hero-question, page-hero-northstar-value, page-hero-action-title, page-hero-action-cta) is present on every dashboard page with the exact spec questions/North Star values: overview '$1.42M', interactions '$412k', conversations '3', reviews '$284k', referrals '$184k', social '84.3k', reddit '13.6k', import '1,521'. Overview shows loop-pre-customer ($531,200) + loop-post-customer ($887,300). Customer Signals renders theme-theme_1/_2/_3 cards. Login right-panel chip reads 'Uplaud · Growth Engine' (stale 'AI trust agents · v1.0' removed). CTA navigation: overview→/business/interactions works; interactions CTA (to:null) does not navigate. Interactions table + drawer + Settings reset workspace all functional (shows 'Workspace reset to zero-state' toast and routes back to /business login).
